---
title: "My first weeks in Canada"
author: "Yi Zhang"
date: 2026-09-11
---

Moving to Canada from mainland China, my first weeks were a string of small surprises. Everything I used to do without thinking — buying food, getting household things — suddenly needed planning. Nothing was wrong, just different, and it took time to find the local rhythm.

Shopping was the clearest example. Back home I had my go-to apps and stores; here I had to learn which kind of store to use for what, from groceries and Asian staples to electronics and tools. Delivery takes days instead of hours, and my first few orders were a mix of wrong guesses and happy discoveries.

Now I have a simple routine: saved lists, weekly flyer checks for deals, and ordering online without much worry, because returns are easy. The first weeks were an adjustment, but today it just feels like home.
